title: Brown Butter Miso Cookies
author: Priya Nair
summary: Chewy cookies with nutty browned butter and a savoury edge from white miso. The miso doesn't read as 'miso' here — it just makes the cookie taste more like itself.

ingredients.item: flaky salt, plus extra for topping

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.text: Melt the butter in a light-colored pan over medium heat. Keep swirling until it turns amber and smells nutty, about 5 minutes. Whisk in the miso off the heat until smooth, then let cool for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the brown butter mixture with both sugars until glossy. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, and whisk until the mixture lightens slightly.

steps.title: Bring in the dry ingredients
steps.text: Fold in the flour, baking soda, and salt just until no dry streaks remain. Fold in the chopped chocolate.

steps.title: Chill the dough
steps.text: Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes — this keeps the cookies from spreading too thin.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Scoop into 14 balls on a lined sheet, spaced well apart. Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 11–13 minutes, until the edges are set but the centers still look soft.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Sprinkle with flaky salt the moment they come out of the oven. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving.

notes: Dough keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze the scooped balls and bake straight from frozen — add a minute or two to the bake time.
